newsitem.title: UK: Finelist says current trade strong.
newsitem.headline: Finelist says current trade strong.

text.p: British automotive parts retailer Finelist Group Plc said on Tuesday its current year's trade had so far been strong with contribution of profits from its recently acquired Motor World unit well ahead of earlier expectations.
The company said the integration of Motor World was progressing well within the timetable set at the time of its acquisition in August 1996.

"The introduction of Finelist's system and culture into Motor World is now well under way and I am very pleased that its performance has exceeded all our expectations," said company chairman Chris Swan.

Finelist also announced the appointment of Brian Ritchie as group purchasing and marketing director. Richie, with an experience of 30 years was previously the marketing director of the company's Motor Factor division.
